description: 2015 Tropical Cyclone Chapala Path is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). This layer shows the movement path of 2015 Tropical Cyclone Chapala. On Monday 2 November 2015, Tropical Cyclone Chapala made a landfall in Yemen; however, its effects were also felt across the Gulf of Aden in Somalia where extensive rainfall was experienced in the Northern Bari region in Bosaso district, Puntland. Coverage: Somalia. The portal files it under the publisher IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). Its tags are geodata, hazards and risk. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
